title: Phone dock: Feedback icon and Objectives sheet
description: On a portrait phone the bottom dock (Players / Objectives / bell / Events) now also carries the Feedback button as a 44 px icon, so nothing floats over the map; and the Objectives window opens as a bottom sheet over the map like Players, with the dock still on top, switching between the three and toggling closed with the same button. Landscape phones (wider than 720 px, no dock) and desktop are unchanged. Before shots were taken on nightly-fixes-2026-10-15 with TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before; after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- EL. Mocked fixtures on a mocked public server.
